name: Cat Cat
summary: Closest village walk from town: follow the path, wheel, and fields in daylight without a guide. The scenic fee at the fall and the village gate are two charges. An adult gate is 150,000 đồng and a child is 70,000 đồng, from 1 m to 1.3 m or to under 1.4 m. Closing time is 17:30 or 18:00.
fee: Check on arrival. Scenic fee and village gate are different.
getThere: Walk or a short ride from town.
heroCaption: The water wheel, the field, and the boardwalk at Cat Cat

notice.title: Pay the scenic fee and the gate
notice.body: From 1 January 2025 the scenic fee for Thác Cát Cát is 10,000 đồng from age 16 and 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. The village gate is a second ticket. Pay each charge on its own.

body: Cat Cat is the closest of the community walks in use since 2005. The village is thôn Cát Cát, xã Tả Van, and also San Sả Hồ commune. The 2025 xã Tả Van absorbed xã Hoàng Liên, and the waterfall is still placed in xã Hoàng Liên. You can walk it without a guide.

Performances run 9:00–9:40, 10:00–10:40, 11:00–11:40, 14:00–14:40, 15:00–15:40, 16:00–16:40, and 17:00–17:40. Set the length of the path around those slots. The houses, the path, and a pond sit under the cloud on the slope above the wheel.
The scenic fee and the village gate are two prices. An adult gate is 150,000 đồng. A child is 70,000 đồng, from 1 m to 1.3 m or from 1 m to under 1.4 m. Under 1 m is free.

figures.caption: Houses, the path, and a pond under the cloud
figures.alt: Cat Cat houses and a pond on a terraced slope in fog

gettingThere: The village is the short trip from the church, on foot or by a ride. The waterfall is inside the same walk, and it has its own scenic fee.

legs.heading: From the stone church
legs.body: Walk or take a short ride from the church.

hours: 06:30–18:00, 07:00–18:00, or 6:30–17:30. Performance slots run through the day at the times above.
admissionNote: Scenic fee for Thác Cát Cát from 1 January 2025: 10,000 đồng from age 16, 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. Village gate: adult 150,000 đồng. Child 70,000 đồng from 1 m to 1.3 m, or from 1 m to under 1.4 m. Under 1 m is free. The scenic fee and the gate are two prices.
